envelope.description: Add the pure LogModel core (LogLine/LogFilter/LogCategory/LogLevels + parseLogLine + matchesFilter)

body.title: Add the pure LogModel core (LogLine/LogFilter/LogCategory/LogLevels + parseLogLine + matchesFilter)
body.summary: New debug/LogModel.kt mirroring the CLI byte-for-byte: data class LogLine{raw:String,timeMs:Long?,level:Int?,module:String?,msg:String?} + parseLogLine(raw):LogLine (Gson JsonParser best-effort: time->timeMs, level->level, name->module, msg->msg; non-JSON/malformed -> raw only, never throws); data class LogFilter{minLevel:Int?,module:String?,text:String?} + matchesFilter(line,filter):Boolean (minLevel drops no-level; module case-insensitive substring on module, no-module dropped; text case-insensitive substring over raw incl. non-JSON; ANDed; empty matches all); enum LogCategoryId{DAEMON,AGENT} + data class LogCategory{id,title,stem} + object LogCategories(all=[Daemon('daemon'),Agent('agent')]); object LogLevels(trace10/debug20/info30/warn40/error50/fatal60 + label(Int?):String + parseLevel(String):Int?). Pure, no platform.
acceptanceChecks: LogLine/LogFilter/LogCategory/LogCategoryId/LogLevels match the CLI shapes; parseLogLine + matchesFilter mirror the CLI byte-for-byte and never throw
LogLevels carries the exact numeric map (trace10..fatal60); parseLevel handles a name, a numeric string, and '' (->null); label falls back to the raw number for an unknown level
The file is pure Kotlin (no IntelliJ-platform import); an empty LogFilter matches every line

tests.name: LogModelTest.parseLogLineMirrorsCli (canonical pino-JSON, name-but-no-msg, non-JSON, partial JSON -> raw only, never throws)
LogModelTest.matchesFilterMirrorsCli (minLevel keep/drop incl. no-level; module substring incl. no-module; text over raw incl. non-JSON; ANDed; empty matches all)
